issues: 27099, 27112: The printed VERO asserts AM is necessary for a minor without A1, but a minor can hold B1 from age 16 and art. 125(2)(d) makes any category valid for AM vehicles, subject to restrictions. The drafts merely say AM is available or describe its scope and do not address this conflict. Independently adjudicate the exact printed statements, preserve their verdicts, and explain any confirmed ambiguity consistently in all four languages; see https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-115/ and https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-125/.

27101, 27105: The explanations simply restate that the registration certificate must be carried or shown. Add the document’s role or another supported decisive distinction to explain why it is required rather than repeating the question.

27117: The explanation only repeats that theory and practical tests must both be passed; add the distinct purpose of the two tests or another supported reason, with evidence, rather than restating the question.

27102, 27107: The cited registro.patente.it circular URL could not be fetched in this review.
